items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: there would be guys like Chu Berry and Johnny Russell and, oh, Frank Newton

ctx.x: At the end of Reel 1 you were just about to tell me about a place in -- or were you just starting to tell me -- in Harlem.

Oh, yes. The Alexander Bar and Grill on the corner of 126th Street and 7th Avenue. They had this room, this back room there, where there was a session every night. You'd go in there and there would be guys like Chu Berry and Johnny Russell and, oh, Frank Newton, and guys from the Ellington band, anybody that was around. And that's the first time I ran into Billie Holiday. She came in there and she was in bobby socks. The first time I ever heard her sing, they let her sing. It was quite a place, you know, before…
